reason: Both memos misstate the ad decline in the same way: each spreads the 36% one-year drop over two years and projects about $67,000 for 2027, so neither is more honest. B is more persuasive to the board members from advertising and sales. It answers "why not run both," counts the cost of selling ads, states the 2027 cash gap more fully with a clear checkpoint, and offers a concrete role for the colleague of 11 years where A leaves a placeholder.
